caption: The whole agency, as one system
vo: This is Targeted OS, from Accelerated Experiences LLC — the operating system for a marketing agency. Not another tool in the stack. The stack, replaced. What you're about to see is the real system, live in a browser, running on seeded data you can touch.

caption: Walk in to the whole picture
vo: You walk in to the Command Center. Open pipeline, what was won this quarter, live campaigns, posts waiting for approval — the whole agency at a glance, and every number on this board is computed from the floor underneath it, not typed in.

caption: Numbers you can walk into
vo: Every card opens into the room it came from. The pipeline snapshot is the real pipeline. And that button on the right routes a question through an org of AI seats that argue it out before anything comes back to you.

caption: One calendar, every commitment
vo: The calendar is the agency's one honest schedule — launches, deadlines, reviews and bookings in a single place, so nothing lives in one person's head or one person's inbox.

caption: One book, every relationship
vo: Contacts is the one book. Clients, prospects, vendors and press, with the history attached. When a name comes up, anyone on the team can see who they are and where things stand.

caption: Video, without leaving the OS
vo: Connect is video calling inside the operating system. A client review or a standup happens right here, on the same record as the work — no third subscription, no lost meeting notes.

caption: The Hall of Records
vo: Records is the filing system — one place, one current version of every document that governs a job or a client. Nobody guesses which copy is right, because there is only one.

caption: The pipeline is the CRM
vo: New business runs through the pipeline room. Every deal has a stage, a value and a next step, and the board never disagrees with the Command Center, because they are the same data.

caption: Deals move, or they say why not
vo: Work the stages left to right. A deal that stalls is visible the day it stalls — not at the end of the month when someone finally updates a spreadsheet.

caption: The Estimating Machine
vo: This is the Estimating Machine. Scope a job, and it prices the work from your own rates and your own margins — so the number you quote is a number the books can live with.

caption: Priced on real margin
vo: The estimate shows what the job costs, what it bills, and what the agency actually keeps. Real-margin pricing, before the proposal goes out — not a postmortem after the job loses money.

caption: Campaigns, end to end
vo: Campaigns is where client work lives — every campaign with its channels, budget and state. What's live, what's scheduled, what's waiting on someone. The whole room reads in one pass.

caption: The social queue
vo: Social is a working queue, not a wish list. Posts are drafted, scheduled and approved here — and nothing goes out on its own. Publishing is a fence, and a human holds the gate.

caption: Research that wins pitches
vo: Market research is the craft under the whole agency. This room holds the findings — the market, the competitors, the audience — filed and current, so every pitch starts from evidence instead of a hunch.

caption: The Creative Studio
vo: The studio is where the making happens — briefs, assets and versions in one place, tied to the campaign they belong to. The latest file is always the one you're looking at.

caption: Client sites, made in-house
vo: The website builder turns the agency into its own web shop. Client sites get built, previewed and shipped from inside the OS — another line of revenue that used to be an outsourced cost.

caption: The books, computed live
vo: Books and margins. Revenue, costs and what the agency keeps, computed from the same floor as everything else. These are the numbers the OS can prove — not a reconstruction at month end.

caption: Know what every job keeps
vo: Margin by client and by job. The work that pays for the agency, and the work that quietly doesn't, side by side. That one view changes what an owner says yes to.

caption: People Ops, honestly
vo: HR holds the team — human seats and AI seats in the same table, because both do real work here. Onboarding, roles and access, so the right people see the right things.

caption: The desk that keeps it running
vo: Operations is the connective tissue — the follow-up calendar and the filing that makes sure nothing released by the org quietly drops on the floor.

caption: Law · advisory, fenced
vo: The law room reads contracts and flags exposure — and it is deliberately humble. It is not a lawyer, it says so, and anything with real risk routes to a licensed human. That fence is the feature.

caption: System health, in plain words
vo: IT watches the systems the agency actually depends on and answers in three words — clear, watch, or intervene. No dashboard theater. Just whether you can work right now.

caption: The agent org
vo: This is the engine — an org of AI departments, each one a chain: a head, an executive, and a triad where two opposing lenses argue and a pacemaker is the only voice out.

caption: Confidence gates, on the record
vo: Every conclusion carries a confidence score and its reasons, tagged data or assumption. Under the bar, it doesn't release — it says a human is needed. You can watch every hop on the bus, in order.

caption: Ghost Mode — the Approval Desk
vo: And this is the deal the whole system is built on. The org runs the agency, but nothing sends, spends or publishes on its own. The true decisions land on this desk, one card at a time — and the goal is a desk that stays nearly empty.

caption: Meetings, on the record
vo: Meetings get a room of their own — scheduled, joined and filed against the client they belong to, so what was said and what was promised has an address.

caption: Fit it to your agency
vo: That pill in the top bar is the configurator. Start from a package, then take rooms off or add them, and the price moves with it — the build fits the agency instead of the agency fitting the build.

caption: Walk in — you cannot hurt it
vo: Targeted OS is a white-label build from Accelerated Experiences LLC. Your brand, your domain, your data — and you keep every dollar of your revenue. The showroom you just watched is open right now. Walk in and try the real thing.
